🥦 Raw Ingredients — Smart Meal Planning

Turn the ingredients in your fridge into meal ideas using AI-powered scanning.

What This Feature Does

Scan your fridge or pantry and SeeFood will detect what ingredients you have. It then recommends meal recipes based on available items — helping you cook smarter and reduce food waste.

How It Works

  1. Scan your fridge or ingredients
  2. AI detects available food items
  3. Recipes are generated based on ingredients
  4. You choose a recipe and start cooking

Why It’s Useful

  • No more wondering what to cook
  • Reduce food waste
  • Save money and time
